citations.quote: Without a credit card: you get $1 of credit when you create your account. It's a one-time credit, and it expires after 7 days.
With a credit card: you get $5 of usage every month.

When you use up the $5, your organization moves to Pay As You Go automatically, so nothing stops. The month's $5 is removed, and the whole month's usage is billed at standard rates from the first cent, not just the usage above $5.
